draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Maple Dynamics' setup
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for the update — no rush at all, and good to know getting everyone set up is on the list this week.

One thing that usually makes the rest easier: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating one real project first gives your team something to land in. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Happy to walk through that first project with you on a short call this week — just say the word.

Best,
Nadia
